title: Quiet Utility
thesis: A calm, familiar Mac utility that makes storage decisions easy to read.
borrow: Restrained chrome, generous whitespace, predictable sidebar and one clear action.
apply: Warm white surfaces, forest-green emphasis, 48 pt free-space figure and simple review rows.
risk: Can feel anonymous unless typography, empty states and small interactions have care.
kit: SF Pro; 4/8 pt spacing; 8–12 pt corners; thin separators; semantic green only for neutral progress.

title: Native Glass
thesis: A contemporary Mac surface with floating navigation and quiet, solid content.
borrow: Material layering and control separation, while retaining platform-specific behavior.
apply: Rounded floating navigation above an opaque reading sheet; cool blue accents.
risk: Transparency can reduce contrast. This static Figma study approximates layering; it does not reproduce live Liquid Glass refraction.
kit: System materials for navigation; SF Pro; solid file lists; Reduce Transparency and Increase Contrast alternatives.

title: Precision Dark
thesis: A diagnostic workspace for people running AI tools and developer environments.
borrow: Strong alignment, restrained borders and consistent information density.
apply: Dark panels, monospaced capacity readouts, a compact review queue and provider-level detail.
risk: Dense data can intimidate casual users; a light appearance and good search remain necessary.
kit: SF Pro + IBM Plex Mono for metrics; charcoal hierarchy; lavender selection; compact rows without tiny hit targets.

title: Storage Journal
thesis: Storage presented as a readable report with reasons, rather than a wall of charts.
borrow: Document typography, paper tones, clear sections and considered margins.
apply: Serif headlines, numbered findings and a reserve summary in the margin.
risk: Long prose is slower for comparing hundreds of files. Use tables inside the detailed review.
fit: Best for explanations and document review
kit: Ancizar Serif headlines + SF Pro body; warm paper palette; narrow rules; explicit section numbers.

title: Friendly Companion
thesis: A friendly guide reduces intimidation without encouraging reckless deletion.
borrow: Simple rounded shapes and a consistent, readable illustration language.
apply: An original disk companion, rounded type and three understandable review steps.
risk: Rewards for deleting can pressure users into mistakes. No points, streaks or celebration of destructive actions.
kit: SF Pro Rounded; original vector character; restrained lime and cream; calm confirmation states; static motion fallback.

title: Bold Blocks
referenceType: Brand / website graphic, not a Mac UI
thesis: An unmistakable graphic identity built from large type and decisive contrast.
borrow: Flat color, bold typography and visible borders.
apply: A reserve poster beside a structured review panel; pink, yellow and ink.
risk: If every element shouts, real warnings lose priority. Detailed file review should become quieter.
kit: SF Pro Bold; square panels; 2 pt borders; yellow/pink blocks; separate warning and destructive-action colors.

title: Storage Instrument
referenceType: Physical hardware reference, not software evidence
thesis: Your storage behaves like an instrument you can inspect and control.
borrow: Labeled readouts, panel grouping and restrained functional color.
apply: A large LCD-like capacity readout, review channels and an orange action.
risk: Physical metaphors can become obscure. Keep normal file names, keyboard behavior and explicit button labels.
kit: IBM Plex Mono readouts + SF Pro labels; grey-green panels; small-radius corners; orange controls, never unlabeled knobs.

title: Soft Expressive
thesis: Friendly, expressive hierarchy that remains understandable at a glance.
borrow: Purposeful shape contrast, focused color and differences in visual weight.
apply: Asymmetric reserve tiles, generous curves and quieter review categories.
risk: Unusual arrangements and missing labels can hurt usability. Android research does not validate this macOS design.
kit: SF Pro; lilac tonal layers; 26–44 pt feature corners; asymmetric summary only; conventional file lists.

title: Swiss Index
source: Museum für Gestaltung / Swiss graphic design
referenceType: Linked primary reference; no third-party image copied
thesis: Let alignment and typographic hierarchy do the organizational work.
borrow: Asymmetric hierarchy, precise rules and disciplined alignment.
apply: A section rail and large headline lead into three aligned capacity values and stable rows.
risk: An austere composition can feel distant and waste space if headings dominate.
kit: SF Pro; warm white and red; square sections; strong baseline relationships; little ornament.

title: Civic Clarity
referenceType: Linked primary reference; no third-party image copied
thesis: Make each consequential decision understandable before proceeding.
borrow: Plain language, clear steps and an explicit explanation of the next action.
apply: A three-step review begins with understanding storage; a side panel explains what follows.
risk: Frequent users may find a wizard slow. Preserve selections and offer an informed expert route.
kit: SF Pro; blue/white; visible focus and labels; strong button hierarchy; step and evidence components.

title: Spatial Atlas
referenceType: Linked primary reference; no third-party image copied
thesis: Reveal where candidate storage is concentrated, then inspect exact evidence.
borrow: Area-based hierarchy paired with an exact-value inspector.
apply: A map represents only the 34.6 GB candidate subset; 31.2 GB AI and 3.4 GB apps remain labelled.
risk: Area is hard to compare precisely. Provide a list alternative and never imply this subset covers the whole disk.
kit: SF Pro + monospaced values; dark teal; lime selection; explicit map scope, selection and inspector roles.

title: Calm Ambient
referenceType: Linked primary reference; no third-party image copied
thesis: Keep storage awareness available with minimal interruption.
borrow: Peripheral status that opens into focused detail when needed.
apply: A menu-bar indicator opens a concise capacity popover with a meaningful route to review.
risk: Quiet must not hide scan failure or a target that cannot be achieved. This is a concept, not a running monitor.
kit: Native menu-bar conventions; compact SF Pro; stable status states; threshold events and user-controlled notifications.

title: Retro Desktop
referenceType: Linked primary reference; no third-party image copied
thesis: Use a familiar desktop metaphor with a deliberately nostalgic identity.
borrow: Economical icon shapes, visible menus and strong outlines.
apply: An original pixel-inspired disk glyph accompanies clear file-review rows and current storage figures.
risk: Historical appearance must not break modern keyboard conventions or imply obsolete behavior.
kit: Monochrome/cream; 2 pt borders; original pixel icon family; readable SF Pro text; current native interaction behavior.

title: Memphis Studio
referenceType: Linked primary reference; no third-party image copied
thesis: Give a serious utility a memorable, expressive visual identity.
borrow: Surprising color, offset geometry and decorative pattern.
apply: A yellow-and-purple summary contrasts with a stable review column. Decorative shapes do not encode bytes.
risk: Strong decoration competes with warnings. The product must never make deletion feel like a game.
kit: SF Pro Bold; yellow and purple; offset panels; geometric illustration tokens; separate semantic warning colors.

title: Organic Garden
referenceType: Linked primary reference; no third-party image copied
thesis: Give the utility a warm organic character while keeping quantities exact.
borrow: Nature-related contours paired with a disciplined underlying grid.
apply: Leaf-like decoration and serif headlines frame plain GB values and conventional review controls.
risk: Botanical imagery does not prove environmental benefit, psychological calm or storage health.
kit: Ancizar Serif + SF Pro; forest tones and warm paper; botanical ornament; exact numerical labels; stable row anatomy.

title: Command Workbench
referenceType: Linked primary reference; no third-party image copied
thesis: Make repeat storage tasks directly reachable while exposing their consequences.
borrow: Searchable commands and a context-sensitive preview.
apply: A command list previews an action; Enter opens review instead of executing deletion.
risk: Fuzzy matching can select the wrong action. Use a separate explicit confirmation for irreversible work.
mac: High if keyboard behavior is native
kit: SF Pro + monospaced shortcuts; dark neutral panels; visible active result; command, effect-preview and review components.
